name: std::ranges::drop_while_view<V,Pred>::end
intro:
Returns a sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the drop_while_view.

Effectively returns ranges::end(base_), where base_ is the underlying view.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the view.

summary: Returns a sentinel or an iterator representing the end of the drop_while_view.
